query: I am a solo developer building a personal portfolio and technical blog and care mostly about SEO and fast page loads
ground_truth_notes: Any static-first site generator or SEO-friendly framework is acceptable.

query: Our team's monorepo CI takes 25 minutes; we want faster builds and test caching
ground_truth_notes: Monorepo build tools with caching and affected-project detection all solve this.

known_contradictions.topic: task graph vs package manager workspaces
known_contradictions.position_a: Dedicated build tools (Nx/Bazel) scale to large monorepos with fine-grained caching
known_contradictions.position_b: pnpm workspaces with simple scripts are enough below ~10 packages

query: An enterprise needs a single entry point for all north-south API traffic with auth, rate limiting and observability
ground_truth_notes: API gateways with plugin ecosystems for auth/rate-limit/observability are all valid.

known_contradictions.position_a: A dedicated API gateway handles north-south traffic best
known_contradictions.position_b: A service mesh like Istio subsumes gateway concerns for east-west and north-south alike

query: Our SaaS startup needs authentication with social login, SSO and MFA without building it ourselves
ground_truth_notes: Hosted or self-hosted identity providers with social login/SSO/MFA all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Managed identity providers reduce compliance and maintenance burden
known_contradictions.position_b: Self-hosted Keycloak keeps data on-prem and avoids per-user pricing

query: I want to give my small team self-serve dashboards over a Postgres database without writing a frontend
ground_truth_notes: Self-hosted BI tools that connect directly to Postgres are all acceptable.

query: An e-commerce company needs reliable event delivery between order, payment and inventory services
ground_truth_notes: Message brokers with delivery guarantees and consumer groups all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Kafka's replayable log is better for event sourcing and multi-consumer fan-out
known_contradictions.position_b: RabbitMQ's routing and per-message acking fit request-reply workloads better

query: Our app sends welcome emails, receipts and password resets; we want reliable delivery with webhooks
ground_truth_notes: Transactional email providers with webhooks and delivery tracking all qualify.

query: I am an indie developer launching a SaaS and want subscription billing with the least tax and compliance hassle
ground_truth_notes: Merchant-of-record billing platforms simplify tax compliance; Stripe also qualifies.

known_contradictions.topic: merchant of record vs direct processor
known_contradictions.position_a: Merchant-of-record platforms absorb global tax and compliance
known_contradictions.position_b: Direct processors like Stripe offer lower fees and more control

query: Our team ships LLM features and needs to trace, evaluate and debug prompt quality in production
ground_truth_notes: LLM observability and evaluation platforms all satisfy tracing and eval needs.

known_contradictions.topic: open source vs managed LLM observability
known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Langfuse keeps traces in-house
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed LangSmith reduces ops burden for LangChain users

query: A data team needs to orchestrate hundreds of batch jobs with retries, backfills and dependencies
ground_truth_notes: Workflow orchestrators with DAG scheduling, retries and backfills all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: DAG schedulers like Airflow are the standard for batch pipelines
known_contradictions.position_b: Durable execution engines like Temporal handle long-running and event-driven flows better

query: Our team wants error tracking with source maps, release tracking and alerting for a Next.js app
ground_truth_notes: Error tracking platforms with source maps and release health all qualify.

query: I want one codebase for an iOS and Android app with a small team and no native specialists
ground_truth_notes: Cross-platform mobile frameworks sharing one codebase are all acceptable.

known_contradictions.position_a: Flutter's compiled rendering gives more consistent UI across platforms
known_contradictions.position_b: React Native reuses web skills and has a larger ecosystem

query: Our small team needs an internal admin UI for CRUD operations without building a frontend from scratch
ground_truth_notes: Low-code internal tool platforms all satisfy CRUD admin needs.

query: An enterprise needs secrets management with rotation, audit logs and approval workflows
ground_truth_notes: Secrets managers with rotation and audit features all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Vault keeps secrets inside the perimeter
known_contradictions.position_b: SaaS secret managers are faster to adopt for cloud-native teams

query: I want to run open-weight LLMs on my own GPU server for internal prototyping
ground_truth_notes: Local LLM serving runtimes all qualify for self-hosted inference.

known_contradictions.topic: throughput engine vs ease of use
known_contradictions.position_a: vLLM maximizes throughput for production serving
known_contradictions.position_b: Ollama's simple CLI suits prototyping on laptops and small servers

query: Our e-commerce site needs typo-tolerant product search with facets under 50ms
ground_truth_notes: Search engines with typo tolerance and facets all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Meilisearch/Typesense keeps cost flat at scale
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed Algolia removes infra burden and tuning effort

query: An enterprise runs workloads on AWS and Azure and wants one infrastructure-as-code layer for both
ground_truth_notes: Multi-cloud IaC tools all qualify; Crossplane's control-plane approach also counts.

known_contradictions.position_a: Declarative HCL (Terraform) is safer for review-heavy enterprise change
known_contradictions.position_b: General-purpose languages (Pulumi) enable real logic and reuse

query: I want to automate personal workflows like RSS-to-newsletter and form-to-Slack without coding
ground_truth_notes: No-code automation platforms with visual builders all qualify.

query: Our marketing team needs to publish blog posts and landing pages with a headless CMS our developers can extend
ground_truth_notes: Open-source headless CMS platforms with content modeling all qualify.

query: Our ML platform team wants consistent features between training and serving with point-in-time correctness
ground_truth_notes: Feature stores with point-in-time joins between training and serving all qualify.

known_contradictions.topic: open source vs managed feature store
known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Feast avoids vendor lock-in
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed Tecton handles streaming features and ops

query: Our product team wants A/B experiments with feature flags and automatic readout of business metrics
ground_truth_notes: Experimentation platforms with flags and metric readouts all qualify.

query: I want push and in-app notifications for a small mobile app without managing a backend
ground_truth_notes: Notification platforms abstracting push delivery all qualify, including Firebase Cloud Messaging.

known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Novu keeps notification data in-house
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed OneSignal handles device tokens and delivery optimization

query: Our support team needs shared inboxes, ticketing and canned responses that scale to thousands of tickets
ground_truth_notes: Customer support platforms with ticketing and shared inbox all qualify.

query: Our team is building multiplayer collaboration with presence cursors and live document sync
ground_truth_notes: Realtime infrastructure for presence and sync all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: PartyKit runs co-located with your app logic
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed Ably guarantees global latency SLAs

query: I want a reproducible local development environment with all services as code
ground_truth_notes: Environment-as-code tools that reproduce local stacks all qualify.

query: Our team wants type-safe RPC between a Go backend and TypeScript frontend with streaming support
ground_truth_notes: RPC frameworks with generated types and streaming all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: gRPC offers the richest streaming and ecosystem
known_contradictions.position_b: Connect's HTTP-first protocol is friendlier to browsers and proxies

query: An enterprise wants S3-compatible object storage on its own hardware with erasure coding
ground_truth_notes: Self-hosted S3-compatible object stores with redundancy all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Ceph's RADOS gives full distributed consistency at scale
known_contradictions.position_b: MinIO's simpler architecture is easier to operate for moderate scale

query: I want to publish developer docs with versioning and search for my open-source project
ground_truth_notes: Static documentation site generators with versioning/search all qualify.

query: Our support team wants a visual LLM chatbot builder with drag-and-drop workflows and knowledge bases
ground_truth_notes: Visual LLM app builders with knowledge bases all qualify.

query: Our data platform needs ACID transactions on Parquet files in a data lake
ground_truth_notes: Open table formats bringing ACID to data lakes all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Delta Lake has the deepest ecosystem with Databricks
known_contradictions.position_b: Iceberg is engine-neutral and adopted by Snowflake and AWS

query: Our team wants automated dependency vulnerability scanning and update pull requests in CI
ground_truth_notes: Dependency scanners with auto-PR updates all qualify.

query: I am building an offline-first mobile app that must sync local data with the server later
ground_truth_notes: Offline-first local databases with sync paths all qualify.

known_contradictions.topic: SQL vs object database for mobile
known_contradictions.position_a: SQLite with a sync layer is predictable and battle-tested
known_contradictions.position_b: Realm's object model and live queries simplify reactive UIs

query: An enterprise needs declarative Kubernetes application delivery with GitOps and rollbacks
ground_truth_notes: GitOps and declarative delivery tools for Kubernetes all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Helm's templating is the ecosystem standard for packaging
known_contradictions.position_b: Kustomize overlays avoid template logic and stay pure YAML

query: Our team manages hundreds of prompts across applications and wants versioning, evals and collaborative review
ground_truth_notes: Prompt management platforms with versioning and evals all qualify.

query: I am launching an online store and want a composable commerce backend with a modern developer experience
ground_truth_notes: Commerce platforms with storefront APIs all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Shopify removes all infra concerns
known_contradictions.position_b: Open-source Medusa/Saleor allow full customization

query: Our team needs lightweight pub/sub messaging between edge devices and the cloud with tiny payloads
ground_truth_notes: Lightweight messaging systems for device-to-cloud all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Brokered systems (NATS/EMQX) give delivery guarantees and routing
known_contradictions.position_b: Brokerless ZeroMQ minimizes latency and moving parts

query: Our ML team wants experiment tracking with model registry and hyperparameter comparison
ground_truth_notes: ML experiment tracking platforms with model registry all qualify.

known_contradictions.topic: open source vs managed experiment tracking
known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted MLflow avoids per-seat pricing
known_contradictions.position_b: Managed W&B provides collaboration and integrations out of the box

query: I need background job processing with retries and scheduled tasks in a small Python service
ground_truth_notes: Python background task queues with retries all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Celery's ecosystem covers every broker and workflow pattern
known_contradictions.position_b: Dramatiq/Huey are simpler and adequate for most services

query: Our team wants to scaffold a CRUD REST API with auth, validation and OpenAPI docs in days
ground_truth_notes: Batteries-included backend frameworks with generators all qualify.

query: An enterprise wants security scanning inside pull requests without slowing down developers
ground_truth_notes: Static application security testing tools with CI integration all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Semgrep's rule patterns are fast and easy to write
known_contradictions.position_b: CodeQL's semantic queries find deeper data-flow issues

query: I am starting a paid newsletter and want subscriber management with landing pages and analytics
ground_truth_notes: Newsletter platforms with subscriber management all qualify.

query: Our data team wants interactive Python dashboards embedded in an internal web app
ground_truth_notes: Python data app frameworks with embeddable dashboards all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Streamlit's script model is fastest to prototype
known_contradictions.position_b: Dash's component model gives finer layout control

query: An enterprise needs long-running business processes with human approval steps and audit trails
ground_truth_notes: Workflow engines supporting human tasks and durability all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: BPMN lets business analysts design processes visually
known_contradictions.position_b: Code-first Temporal is more testable and versionable for engineers

query: I want login for a hobby web app with email verification and social providers in one afternoon
ground_truth_notes: Auth-as-a-service or auth libraries with social providers all qualify.

query: Our team needs centralized log aggregation with querying and alerting for Kubernetes workloads
ground_truth_notes: Log aggregation platforms with query and alerting all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Self-hosted Loki keeps log storage cost predictable
known_contradictions.position_b: SaaS Datadog removes operational burden

query: An enterprise running 200 microservices needs service-to-service traffic management with mTLS and retries
ground_truth_notes: Service meshes providing mTLS and traffic policies all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Sidecar-based Istio has the richest feature set
known_contradictions.position_b: Sidecarless approaches (Cilium, ambient) cut resource overhead

query: Our team wants beautiful API reference docs auto-generated from OpenAPI specs
ground_truth_notes: API documentation platforms consuming OpenAPI all qualify.

query: I want to add natural-sounding voice to my AI assistant with low latency streaming
ground_truth_notes: Streaming TTS APIs with low latency all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: ElevenLabs leads on naturalness
known_contradictions.position_b: Azure/OpenAI streaming offers lower latency and cheaper scale

query: An enterprise needs a distributed caching layer with persistence options and cluster mode
ground_truth_notes: Distributed in-memory caches with clustering all qualify.

known_contradictions.position_a: Redis data structures enable queues, streams and pub/sub in one system
known_contradictions.position_b: Memcached's simplicity delivers raw cache speed

query: Our team wants persistent memory for AI agents across conversations with retrieval and personalization
ground_truth_notes: Agent memory layers with retrieval and profile persistence all qualify.

known_contradictions.topic: memory as a service vs embedded library
known_contradictions.position_a: Memory services centralize profiles across sessions and users
known_contradictions.position_b: Embedded libraries keep memory local and simple
